about_the_game:
This asset set features character chips depicting various objects in flames, along with tilesets for charred items and furniture left behind after a fire.

You can place flame chips over scorched buildings to create the effect of structures actively burning.

Adding more of these assets allows you to create a devastated village or town that has been completely burned down.

For the most realistic animation, adjust the event's autonomous movement settings to:

Movement Speed: 4x Faster

Movement Frequency: Highest

*******************************************

Tiles: 1 file

Characters: 2 files

*******************************************

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
